title: Earth reference flame
summary: Methane jet in sea-level air at 1 g, open boundary: transient 2-D axisymmetric laminar reacting-flow solve with stored temperature, velocity, species and heat-release fields.
expected_behaviour: After ignition a buoyant diffusion flame attaches above the burner; peak temperature settles near the one-step-chemistry flame temperature (over-predicted versus detailed chemistry).
acceptance_checks: Peak temperature between 1800 K and 2500 K at the end of the run.
At least 5 stored field frames can be inspected.
